Resolves #3240

Fixes `Neo.tree.List#filter` (`src/tree/List.mjs`) and `Docs.view.MainContainerController#onNavigationSearchFieldChange` (`docs/app/view/MainContainerController.mjs`) so filtering tree lists hides unmatched siblings and folders per item, collapses child folders inside matched parent folders when those child folders contain no match of their own, restores `'flex'` display when items are visible, avoids injecting empty highlight spans when clearing the filter, and removes the dead `tutorials-treelist` call from the Docs app controller. Also extracts `#setFolderOpen(node, isOpen)` to deduplicate folder expand/collapse VDOM mutations across `collapseAll`, `expandAll`, `expandParents`, `filter`, and `onItemClick` (net `-11` lines in `src/tree/List.mjs`).

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; baseline `PR Baseline` jobs run in CI.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit tests in `test/playwright/unit/tree/List.spec.mjs` exercising `Neo.tree.List#filter` VDOM output across leaf matches, folder matches with child folders, and filter clearing) → L2 required (no structured ACs on #3240).

## AC Evidence
No structured ACs on #3240.

| Requirement (#3240) | Verification |
|---|---|
| Hide folders that do not contain a result | `test/playwright/unit/tree/List.spec.mjs` (`filter hides unmatched siblings and folders, and collapses unmatched child folders inside matched folders`) |
| Show child folders inside a matched folder, but close them when they have no match of their own | `test/playwright/unit/tree/List.spec.mjs` (`filter hides unmatched siblings and folders, and collapses unmatched child folders inside matched folders`) |
| Hide non-matching leaf siblings when a leaf child matches | `test/playwright/unit/tree/List.spec.mjs` (`filter hides unmatched siblings and folders, and collapses unmatched child folders inside matched folders`) |

## Deltas from ticket
- Extracted `#setFolderOpen(node, isOpen)` in `src/tree/List.mjs` to deduplicate folder expand/collapse VDOM mutations across `collapseAll`, `expandAll`, `expandParents`, `filter`, and `onItemClick` (net `-11` lines in `src/tree/List.mjs`), and restored `'flex'` (matching `createItem`) instead of `'list-item'` when unfiltered.
- Deleted the leftover `me.getReference('tutorials-treelist').filter('name', value, null)` call in `docs/app/view/MainContainerController.mjs` (the tutorials section was removed in `6006fb2dc3` / `#5383`, diagnosed on `#3240` in `IC_kwDODSospM8AAAABavGgXw`).

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] None required; covered by unit tests in CI.
